description: Free. Use when a person wants to check the captions before they are burned (names, slang, brand words). Pass a finished transcriptionJobId and the preset or brandPresetId. Returns reviewUrl: a private web editor link (no login, up to 7 days) where they fix text and timing and press Approve or Reject. Only on Approve does the burn run and charge (4 credits per minute). Follow with get_review, or webhookUrl / notifyEmail for review.approved, review.rejected and review.expired events.

autoFit.description: Default true: caption size, words per caption (4 on 9:16, 5 on 1:1, 7 on 16:9), and a default safe zone follow the video shape, so text reads the same at 720p and 1080p and stays clear of app UI. Pass false only when the user wants the preset's exact fixed pixel sizes. Same price.

brandPresetId.description: Id from manage_preset {action:'create', type:'brand'}: applies its font, color, position and logo on top of the preset.

combined.description: Also return SRT/VTT with the burned MP4.

faceAvoid.description: true = move captions off faces (samples faces at 2 fps, same price; result.faceAvoid.faceLayout). Shortcut for styleOverrides.faceAvoid.

highlightWords.description: Shortcut: words or phrases to color in every caption (accent/case-insensitive), e.g. ["AwesomeVideo", "gratis"]. Maps to styleOverrides.wordHighlights rule {id:"custom", words, color}. Same price.

instructions.description: Shown to the reviewer, e.g. 'Revisa nombres de productos'.

maxCredits.description: Refuse the burn on approval if it would exceed this many cents.

notifyEmail.description: Email address that gets a link when the job finishes or fails.

platform.description: Target platform (tiktok, reels, shorts, ...) for safe-zone placement, when supported by burn_captions.

preset.description: Preset id or name for the burn after approval.

styleOverrides.description: Per-call style changes deep-merged onto the preset (same fields as get_catalog {kind:'presets'} style; null removes a field), validated with the renderer schema and bundled fonts. Example {"fontSize":72,"maxWordsPerCaption":2,"wordEntrance":"bounce"}. Same price. No need to manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'}. Every field with examples: get_catalog {kind:'styles'}.

transcriptionJobId.description: Succeeded transcribe job id. Its media must still be stored (48 h).

webhookUrl.description: Gets review.approved / review.rejected / review.expired events and the burn job result when it finishes.

name: request_review

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.

title: Request human review before burning
